profile.name: Projection Agent
profile.description: Reprojects vector artifacts between explicitly identified coordinate reference systems and assigns a CRS when explicitly supplied. The service never guesses an unknown CRS.

skills.name: Coordinate Transformation
skills.description: Transforms vector geometry coordinates to a target CRS or defines an explicit CRS on datasets with missing metadata.

constraints.spatial: Reprojection requires a known source CRS and an explicit target CRS. assign_crs requires an explicit CRS to assign.
other: The service does not infer or guess unknown coordinate reference systems.

execute_task.name: ExecuteTask
execute_task.description: Submits a vector reprojection or explicit CRS assignment task.

instructions.description: Reprojection instruction specifying target CRS (e.g. reproject to EPSG:26918) or assign CRS instruction.

input_datasets.description: Vector dataset in GeoPackage or GeoJSON format.
